blocks.text: Composites bohat kaarguzar aur mufeed jadeed materials hain. Composite do ya zyada materials ka aisa milap hai jo behtar khasiyaton wali cheez banata hai. Aik hissa matrix kehlata hai, aur doosre, jo matrix mein qaid hote hain, reinforcement agents kehlate hain; kuch composites mein aik se zyada reinforcement agent hote hain. Matrix reinforcement ko thame rakhta hai, jab ke reinforcement zyada mazbooti deta hai.

Misal fibreglass hai, jis mein polymer matrix hai aur reinforcement kapre, sheeshe ya carbon par mabni materials ke reshe (fibres) ho sakte hain. Composites ka mazbooti aur wazan ka tanasub achha aur zang se bachao zyada hai, is liye yeh mushkil kaamon ke liye munasib hain: kashtiyon ke dhanche aur gariyon ki bodies fibreglass se banti hain, aur carbon fibre halka aur bohat pa-idar hone ki wajah se hawai jahazon aur khel ke saaman mein wasee taur par use hota hai. Fibreglass deewaron aur chhaton ko garmi aur sardi se bachane (insulation) mein bhi use hota hai (kitab ki Figure 31.3 is ki tasveer hai).

blocks.prompt: Composite mein matrix aur reinforcement ke kirdar batayein.
blocks.explanation: Matrix reinforcement ko apni jagah thame rakhta hai; reinforcement (jaise sheeshe ya carbon ke reshe) zyada mazbooti deta hai.

items: Fibreglass: kashtiyan, gariyan, insulation; carbon fibre: jahaz, khel ka saaman.
